        "contents": "# Allowed Device List Feature — Implementation Plan\n\n## 1) Current state (what already exists)\n\nBased on the current codebase:\n\n- The API layer already supports &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with per-device access flags (&#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess&#96;, &#96;hasHistoryAccess&#96;) and requires both &#96;DeviceID&#96; and &#96;DeviceKey&#96;. This is exposed in &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList(...)&#96;.\n- The app already supports optional DeviceKey management (&#96;SettingsManager.deviceKey&#96;, onboarding page, settings sheet, auth mismatch handling).\n- Known devices are persisted via &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; and represented by &#96;KnownDevice&#96; (currently name, id, color, ordering/group info).\n- Visitor history is already loaded and displayed (&#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel&#96; / visitor history views), including an “add unknown visitor as device” flow.\n\nThis makes the new feature mostly an app-domain/state-management and UX integration project, not a protocol design project.\n\n---\n\n## 2) Key product decisions and rationale\n\n### Decision A: How to track whether the allowed-device-list feature is enabled\n\n**Choose:** explicit immutable activation flag + persisted per-device ACL fields.\n\n- Add a dedicated setting flag, e.g. &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool&#96; in &#96;SettingsManager&#96;.\n- Add ACL fields to each &#96;KnownDevice&#96;:\n  - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool&#96;\n  - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool&#96;\n\n**Why this over “infer from list existence” only?**\n\n- Inference from list/data shape is brittle during migration or partial failures.\n- An explicit flag cleanly models the “one-way activation” requirement (“cannot be disabled”).\n- Per-device ACL fields remain the source of truth for payload generation once enabled.\n\n**Implications:**\n\n- Migration needs defaults for older archived devices.\n- Guardrails are easy: UI and sync logic can branch on &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96;.\n- If enabled but server sync fails, state handling must remain deterministic (see rollout/sync section).\n\n### Decision B: One-way activation behavior\n\n**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).",

        "contents": "    func syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: SyncTrigger) async throws {\n        guard settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled else {\n            return // Feature not enabled, skip sync\n        }\n        \n        // Precondition checks\n        guard let deviceKey = settings.deviceKey, !deviceKey.isEmpty else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.deviceKeyMissing\n        }\n        \n        guard let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.serverURLInvalid\n        }\n        \n        let payload = buildPayloadFromDevices()\n        \n        try await syncQueue.enqueue {\n            try await self.performSync(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                deviceKey: deviceKey,\n                payload: payload,\n                trigger: trigger,\n                maxRetries: 3\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Updates device ACL and syncs full list\n    func upsertDeviceACL(deviceID: String, hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool, hasHistoryAccess: Bool) async throws {\n        guard let device = deviceStore.devices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() == deviceID.uppercased() }) else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.preconditionFailed(\"Device not found: \\(deviceID)\")\n        }\n        \n        device.hasCurrentLocationAccess = hasCurrentLocationAccess\n        device.hasHistoryAccess = hasHistoryAccess\n        \n        try await syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .edit)\n    }\n    \n    /// Removes device and syncs full list\n    func removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID: String) async throws {\n        // Capture snapshot for rollback\n        let snapshot = captureSnapshot()",

Published Properties\n    @Published var currentLocation: CLLocation?\n    @Published var authorizationStatus: CLAuthorizationStatus = .notDetermined\n    @Published var lastUpdateTime: Date?\n    @Published var isTracking: Bool = false\n    @Published var userHeading: Double?\n    @Published private(set) var isHeadingValid: Bool = false\n    @Published var lastServerUpdate: Date?\n    @Published var serverUpdateStatus: ServerUpdateStatus = .idle\n    @Published var updateLog: [UpdateLogEntry] = []\n    @Published var lastBackgroundUpdate: Date?\n    @Published var backgroundUpdateCount: Int = 0\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Properties\n    private let locationManager = CLLocationManager()\n    private let userDefaults = UserDefaults.standard\n    private let backgroundUpdateCountKey = \"miataru_backgroundUpdateCount\"\n    private let lastBackgroundUpdateKey = \"miataru_lastBackgroundUpdate\"\n    private let backgroundMetricsLastResetKey = \"miataru_backgroundMetricsLastReset\"\n    private let lastServerUpdateKey = \"miataru_lastServerUpdate\"\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private let settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    private var foregroundLocationTimer: Timer?\n    private var foregroundLocationUpdateTimerTimeframe: Double = 30\n    private let networkMonitor = NWPathMonitor()\n    @Published private(set) var isNetworkAvailable: Bool = true\n    private let alwaysAuthorizationRequestedKey = \"miataru_always_authorization_requested\"\n    private var lastSmoothedHeading: Double?\n    private let headingSmoothingAlpha: Double = 0.25\n    private let headingAccuracyThreshold: Double = 35",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/Allowed Device List Feature-concept.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 40
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 86
          }
        },
        "contents": "**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).\n  2. Build payload from all known devices (defaults &#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices).\n  3. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n  4. On success, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96; and ACL values.\n\n**Why:** avoids a local “enabled but never seeded” state on first setup.\n\n### Decision C: Canonical synchronization model\n\n**Choose:** when enabled, local known-device list is canonical and server ACL is overwritten with full list on each relevant mutation.\n\n- Mutations: add/remove device, edit ACL toggles, onboarding activation, unknown-device allow/disallow action.\n- Use one central orchestrator service to avoid duplicate ad-hoc sync code.\n\n---\n\n## 3) Architecture changes\n\n## 3.1 Data model and persistence\n\n1. Extend &#96;KnownDevice&#96; to include ACL fields:\n   - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n   - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n2. Update &#96;NSCoding&#96; encode/decode keys with backward-compatible defaults.\n3. Add &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; to &#96;SettingsManager.Keys&#96; and initialize from &#96;UserDefaults&#96;.\n4. Add a local ignored-unknown-devices store (e.g. &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;) containing device IDs explicitly dismissed from the Devices screen unknown list.\n\n### 3.2 Domain service layer (new)\n\nCreate &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96; (singleton or injected service) responsible for:\n\n- Building API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96;.\n- Enforcing preconditions (&#96;deviceKey != nil &amp;&amp; !empty&#96;, valid server URL).\n- Calling &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n- Exposing high-level methods:\n  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList()&#96;\n  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger:)&#96;\n  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:..., hasCurrentLocationAccess:..., hasHistoryAccess:...)&#96;\n  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:...)&#96;\n- Centralized error mapping/user messages/logging.\n\nThis keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.",

        "contents": "---\nname: Allowed Device List Feature\noverview: Implement optional per-device access control (current location and history) with one-way activation, server synchronization, and unknown visitor management. The feature requires DeviceKey and cannot be disabled once enabled.\ntodos:\n  - id: phase1-data-model\n    content: Extend KnownDevice with ACL fields (hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess) and update NSCoding for backward compatibility\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-settings\n    content: Add allowedDeviceListEnabled flag to SettingsManager with UserDefaults persistence\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-ignored-store\n    content: Create IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore singleton for dismissed unknown devices\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-manager\n    content: Implement AllowedDeviceListManager with payload building, sync queue, and transactional rollback\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-onboarding\n    content: Create iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView and integrate into onboarding containers\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-settings-ui\n    content: Add settings entry for allowed device list feature with status display\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-add-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_AddDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-edit-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_EditDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-remove-sync\n    content: Wire device removal to sync full list when feature enabled\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase4-unknown-section\n    content: Add unknown visitors section to iPhone_DevicesView with allow/ignore actions\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-localization\n    content: Add all feature strings to Localizable.xcstrings and run export workflow\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-testing\n    content: Write unit tests for payload mapping, backward compatibility, and sync queue\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"",

        "contents": "# Allowed Device List Feature — Implementation Plan\n\n## 1) Current state (what already exists)\n\nBased on the current codebase:\n\n- The API layer already supports &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with per-device access flags (&#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess&#96;, &#96;hasHistoryAccess&#96;) and requires both &#96;DeviceID&#96; and &#96;DeviceKey&#96;. This is exposed in &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList(...)&#96;.\n- The app already supports optional DeviceKey management (&#96;SettingsManager.deviceKey&#96;, onboarding page, settings sheet, auth mismatch handling).\n- Known devices are persisted via &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; and represented by &#96;KnownDevice&#96; (currently name, id, color, ordering/group info).\n- Visitor history is already loaded and displayed (&#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel&#96; / visitor history views), including an “add unknown visitor as device” flow.\n\nThis makes the new feature mostly an app-domain/state-management and UX integration project, not a protocol design project.\n\n---\n\n## 2) Key product decisions and rationale\n\n### Decision A: How to track whether the allowed-device-list feature is enabled\n\n**Choose:** explicit immutable activation flag + persisted per-device ACL fields.\n\n- Add a dedicated setting flag, e.g. &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool&#96; in &#96;SettingsManager&#96;.\n- Add ACL fields to each &#96;KnownDevice&#96;:\n  - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool&#96;\n  - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool&#96;\n\n**Why this over “infer from list existence” only?**\n\n- Inference from list/data shape is brittle during migration or partial failures.\n- An explicit flag cleanly models the “one-way activation” requirement (“cannot be disabled”).\n- Per-device ACL fields remain the source of truth for payload generation once enabled.\n\n**Implications:**\n\n- Migration needs defaults for older archived devices.\n- Guardrails are easy: UI and sync logic can branch on &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96;.\n- If enabled but server sync fails, state handling must remain deterministic (see rollout/sync section).\n\n### Decision B: One-way activation behavior\n\n**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_SettingsView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_SettingsView: View {\n    @ObservedObject var settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    @State private var showingLocationStatus = false\n    @State private var showingLocationTest = false\n    @State private var showingDeviceKeySheet = false\n    @State private var isActivatingAllowedDeviceList = false\n    @State private var activationError: String? = nil\n    @EnvironmentObject var appState: AppState\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        NavigationView {\n            Form {\n                Section(header: Text(\"track_and_history\")) {\n                    Toggle(\"location_track\", isOn: $settings.trackAndReportLocation)\n                    if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n                        Toggle(\"save_location_history_to_server\", isOn: $settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer)\n\n                        if !settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer {\n                            Picker(\"store_history_before_autoremove\", selection: $settings.locationDataRetentionTime) {\n                                Text(\"30minutes\").tag(30)\n                                Text(\"1hour\").tag(60)\n                                Text(\"2hours\").tag(120)\n                                Text(\"6hours\").tag(360)\n                                Text(\"12hours\").tag(720)\n                                Text(\"24hours\").tag(1440)\n                                Text(\"7days\").tag(10080)\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    Button {\n                        showingDeviceKeySheet = true\n                    } label: {\n                        HStack {\n                            Image(systemName: \"key.card\")\n                                ",

        "contents": "    func syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: SyncTrigger) async throws {\n        guard settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled else {\n            return // Feature not enabled, skip sync\n        }\n        \n        // Precondition checks\n        guard let deviceKey = settings.deviceKey, !deviceKey.isEmpty else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.deviceKeyMissing\n        }\n        \n        guard let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.serverURLInvalid\n        }\n        \n        let payload = buildPayloadFromDevices()\n        \n        try await syncQueue.enqueue {\n            try await self.performSync(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                deviceKey: deviceKey,\n                payload: payload,\n                trigger: trigger,\n                maxRetries: 3\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Updates device ACL and syncs full list\n    func upsertDeviceACL(deviceID: String, hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool, hasHistoryAccess: Bool) async throws {\n        guard let device = deviceStore.devices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() == deviceID.uppercased() }) else {\n            throw AllowedDeviceListError.preconditionFailed(\"Device not found: \\(deviceID)\")\n        }\n        \n        device.hasCurrentLocationAccess = hasCurrentLocationAccess\n        device.hasHistoryAccess = hasHistoryAccess\n        \n        try await syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .edit)\n    }\n    \n    /// Removes device and syncs full list\n    func removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID: String) async throws {\n        // Capture snapshot for rollback\n        let snapshot = captureSnapshot()",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/Allowed Device List Feature-concept.md",
        "range": {

            "line": 40
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 86
          }
        },
        "contents": "**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).\n  2. Build payload from all known devices (defaults &#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices).\n  3. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n  4. On success, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96; and ACL values.\n\n**Why:** avoids a local “enabled but never seeded” state on first setup.\n\n### Decision C: Canonical synchronization model\n\n**Choose:** when enabled, local known-device list is canonical and server ACL is overwritten with full list on each relevant mutation.\n\n- Mutations: add/remove device, edit ACL toggles, onboarding activation, unknown-device allow/disallow action.\n- Use one central orchestrator service to avoid duplicate ad-hoc sync code.\n\n---\n\n## 3) Architecture changes\n\n## 3.1 Data model and persistence\n\n1. Extend &#96;KnownDevice&#96; to include ACL fields:\n   - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n   - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n2. Update &#96;NSCoding&#96; encode/decode keys with backward-compatible defaults.\n3. Add &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; to &#96;SettingsManager.Keys&#96; and initialize from &#96;UserDefaults&#96;.\n4. Add a local ignored-unknown-devices store (e.g. &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;) containing device IDs explicitly dismissed from the Devices screen unknown list.\n\n### 3.2 Domain service layer (new)\n\nCreate &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96; (singleton or injected service) responsible for:\n\n- Building API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96;.\n- Enforcing preconditions (&#96;deviceKey != nil &amp;&amp; !empty&#96;, valid server URL).\n- Calling &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n- Exposing high-level methods:\n  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList()&#96;\n  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger:)&#96;\n  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:..., hasCurrentLocationAccess:..., hasHistoryAccess:...)&#96;\n  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:...)&#96;\n- Centralized error mapping/user messages/logging.\n\nThis keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.\n2. UI shows ACL toggles with defaults &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;.\n3. On save, add to &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, then sync full list.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback to pre-add snapshot and show a localized error explaining restoration.\n\n### 4.3 Edit device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User edits toggles.\n2. Save mutates &#96;KnownDevice&#96;.\n3. Full-list sync is triggered.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.\n\n### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User deletes device.\n2. Remove locally.\n3. Re-send full list without removed device.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.\n\n---\n\n## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)\n\n- Data source:\n  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;\n  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.\n- UI:\n  - New section above known devices.\n  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.\n  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.\n- Visibility:\n  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.\n\n---\n\n## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication\n\nThe feature text should explicitly explain:\n\n- It is optional.\n- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.\n- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.\n- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.\n\nSuggested short onboarding title/body:\n\n- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”\n- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).",

          },

            "lineNumber": 130

            "text": "3. Full-list sync is triggered.",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "1. User deletes device.",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Remove locally.",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Re-send full list without removed device.",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "- Data source:",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "- UI:",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "  - New section above known devices.",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "- Actions:",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "- Visibility:",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "The feature text should explicitly explain:",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "- It is optional.",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "Suggested short onboarding title/body:",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "All strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",
            "lineNumber": 184
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "---\nname: Allowed Device List Feature\noverview: Implement optional per-device access control (current location and history) with one-way activation, server synchronization, and unknown visitor management. The feature requires DeviceKey and cannot be disabled once enabled.\ntodos:\n  - id: phase1-data-model\n    content: Extend KnownDevice with ACL fields (hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess) and update NSCoding for backward compatibility\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-settings\n    content: Add allowedDeviceListEnabled flag to SettingsManager with UserDefaults persistence\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-ignored-store\n    content: Create IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore singleton for dismissed unknown devices\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-manager\n    content: Implement AllowedDeviceListManager with payload building, sync queue, and transactional rollback\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-onboarding\n    content: Create iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView and integrate into onboarding containers\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-settings-ui\n    content: Add settings entry for allowed device list feature with status display\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-add-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_AddDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-edit-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_EditDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-remove-sync\n    content: Wire device removal to sync full list when feature enabled\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase4-unknown-section\n    content: Add unknown visitors section to iPhone_DevicesView with allow/ignore actions\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-localization\n    content: Add all feature strings to Localizable.xcstrings and run export workflow\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-testing\n    content: Write unit tests for payload mapping, backward compatibility, and sync queue\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"",

          },

          {

        },
        "contents": "This keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.\n\n### 3.3 UI flow integration\n\n1. **Onboarding**\n   - Add a dedicated onboarding page for allowed-device-list.\n   - Reuse the same image asset as DeviceKey onboarding.\n   - CTA logic:\n     - If no DeviceKey: primary action opens DeviceKey setup first.\n     - If DeviceKey exists and feature disabled: show enable/setup action.\n     - If already enabled: show configured/success state.\n2. **Settings**\n   - Add entry to review/manage feature state and explanatory text.\n   - Do not provide “disable” action once enabled.\n3. **Add/Edit device dialogs**\n   - If feature is enabled, show two translated toggles.\n   - If feature is **not** enabled yet, keep add/edit/delete dialogs in their current form and do **not** show ACL toggles.\n   - Edit defaults: existing stored values.\n   - Add defaults (requirement): &#96;current = true&#96;, &#96;history = false&#96; for new devices.\n4. **Devices list unknown section**\n   - Add top section only when unknown devices exist in visitor history and are not ignored.\n   - Actions per row:\n     - **Allow/Add** → open add flow with prefilled DeviceID and ACL defaults, then sync full list.\n     - **Ignore/Disallow** → add ID to ignored store (hidden from this list), no deletion from full visitor history.\n\n---\n\n## 4) End-to-end behavior design\n\n### 4.1 Activation sequence\n\n1. User starts allowed-device-list setup (onboarding/settings).\n2. App checks DeviceKey.\n3. If missing, prompt DeviceKey creation first.\n4. On DeviceKey success, build full ACL payload from known devices with initial defaults (&#96;true/true&#96;).\n5. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n6. On ACK, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96;.\n7. From now on, all device list mutations trigger full-list sync.\n\n\n### 4.1a UI gating before feature activation\n\n- Until &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, existing add/change/delete device dialogs remain unchanged.\n- No access-rights toggle controls are rendered in these dialogs before activation.\n- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.",

        "contents": "    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# Allowed Device List Feature — Implementation Plan\n\n## Current State\n\nThe codebase already provides:\n\n- API support: &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList()&#96; in &#96;[Libraries/MiataruClientSwift/Sources/MiataruAPIClient/MiataruAPIClient.swift](Libraries/MiataruClientSwift/Sources/MiataruAPIClient/MiataruAPIClient.swift)&#96; with &#96;MiataruAllowedDevice&#96; payload structure\n- DeviceKey management: &#96;SettingsManager.deviceKey&#96; in &#96;[miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift)&#96;\n- Device persistence: &#96;KnownDevice&#96; and &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; in &#96;[miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDevice.swift](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDevice.swift)&#96; and &#96;[miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift)&#96;\n- Visitor history: &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel&#96; in &#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift)&#96; with &#96;sortedVisitors&#96; property\n\n## Architecture Changes\n\n### Data Model Extensions\n\n**1.         "contents": "    func loadVisitorHistory(showLoading: Bool = true) async {\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            errorMessage = NSLocalizedString(\"visitor_history_error\", comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n            return\n        }\n        \n        if showLoading {\n            isLoading = true\n        }\n        errorMessage = nil\n        \n        do {\n            let ourDeviceId = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            // Request with nil amount to get all available from server\n            APIRequestCounter.shared.record(.getVisitorHistory)\n            let response = try await MiataruAPIClient.getVisitorHistoryWithConfig(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: ourDeviceId,\n                deviceKey: settings.deviceKey,\n                amount: nil\n            )\n            self.visitors = response.MiataruVisitors\n            self.isLoading = false\n        } catch {\n            if let authMessage = DeviceKeyAuthHandler.handle(error: error) {\n                self.errorMessage = authMessage\n            } else {\n                self.errorMessage = NSLocalizedString(\"visitor_history_error\", comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n            }\n            self.isLoading = false\n            debugLog(\"[VisitorHistoryViewModel] Failed to load visitor history: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        let isActive = UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        let interval = Double(settings.outsideMapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n\n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt; interval {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        return true\n    }\n}\n\nstruct VisitorHistoryStateView&lt;Content: View&gt;: View {\n    @ObservedObject var viewModel: VisitorHistoryViewModel",

Implemented the dependency between the ACL toggles.

1. **Automatic disabling**: When "Current Location Access" is disabled, "History Access" is automatically disabled.

2. **Visual feedback**: The "History Access" toggle is disabled when "Current Location Access" is off, indicating it can't be enabled without current location access.

The implementation uses a custom binding on the "Current Location Access" toggle that:
- Updates `tempHasCurrentLocationAccess` when toggled
- Sets `tempHasHistoryAccess` to `false` if current location access is disabled

The "History Access" toggle uses `.disabled(!tempHasCurrentLocationAccess)` so it's only enabled when current location access is on.

This ensures that disabling current location access automatically disables history access, and the UI prevents enabling history access without current location access.

## Summary

**Feature**: Automatic dependency between ACL toggles

**Implementation**:
- When "Current Location Access" is disabled, "History Access" is automatically disabled.
- The "History Access" toggle is disabled when "Current Location Access" is off.

**Technical details**:
- Custom binding on the "Current Location Access" toggle intercepts changes and updates both values.
- Added `.disabled()` modifier to the "History Access" toggle for visual feedback.

**Commit**: `89aedc1f` - "Add dependency: disabling Current Location Access auto-disables History Access"

This ensures that history access cannot be enabled without current location access, maintaining logical consistency in the ACL settings.
